payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute a 2D DP table for longest common prefix length between all pairs of word indices, then brute-force all segments using this table to count non-overlapping occurrences and evaluate abbreviation savings.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D DP (dp[i][j]) to store LCP lengths, enabling O(1) segment equality checks. The main search enumerates start and length, leveraging the DP to count matches. This matches the dp_2d_state subtype as the core technique is a 2D DP table.
